verdict.rationale: Medusa publishes complete, machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specs for its Store and Admin REST APIs, and these specs power the public API reference on docs.medusajs.com/api. That gives a documented, programmatic way to drive the product. The probe 404s at generic OpenAPI paths only show the spec isn't served at well-known URLs; they don't contradict that the API exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end, and the spec is not discoverable at standard well-known paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Medusa maintains complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specifications for the Store (and Admin) REST APIs in the medusajs/medusa repository; they power the docs.medusajs.com/api reference.
